Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Voltaire (author, Wikidata Q9068), died 1778; King of Prussia Frederick II (author, Wikidata Q33550), died 1786; Edouard de Pompery (notes, Wikidata Q37513338), died 1895. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Voltaire, 1694-1778; Frederick II, King of Prussia, 1712-1786; Pompery, Edouard de, 1812-1895 [Commentator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Œuvres complètes de Voltaire avec des notes et une notice historique sur la vie de Voltaire 10. Correspondance avec le roi de Prusse, l'imperatrice de Russie et D'Alembert, 1836, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_WAepDSboBF4C. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 57%, 79%, 64% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Edouard de Pompery, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
